question.text: For listed REIT units on which STT is paid, what is the LTCG tax rate if the units are held for more than 12 months?

answer.text: Exempt from tax if held for more than 12 months

explanation.text: The Logic: For listed REIT units on which STT is paid, LTCG (holding period more than 12 months) is taxed at 12.5% on gains exceeding Rs. 1,25,000 under Section 112A. The STCG rate applies only where the holding period is 12 months or less; this question asks LTCG after more than 12 months. The Trap: Option A ("10% above Rs. 1,00,000") was the older rate before Section 112A was revised. Option C ("20% with indexation under Section 112") does not apply to listed REIT units on which STT is paid. Option D ("Exempt") is incorrect — listed REIT LTCG is not exempt. Note: Trap paragraph repaired and rewritten with accurate option-letter references; unsupported framing removed.
